text:
Owen (AM): Heads-up: MediBank wants an EU-only POC for regulator review. Main asks: confirmed sub-processor list, strict routing so no cross-border failover, and a quick POC price for ~2M tokens/mo. Can we scope and ETA? cc @Tessa
Tessa (Solutions): Quick checks: BYOK for the POC? Hosted geofence acceptable or require dedicated/private? Also need the target latency SLO.
Helena (Customer Sec): No BYOK for POC. Must ensure data plane never leaves EU. SLO target: p95 < 300ms. Need subproc inventory and an attestation letter for auditors. 90-day logs retention required.
Tessa (Solutions): We can do hosted geofence (fast), dedicated EU pool (stronger isolation + SLA), or private VPC (longer lead). We'll propose a routing policy that pins tenant to EU zones and disables cross-border fallthrough. Example snippet we'll give them:
```
residency_policy:
  tenant: medi-bank-poc
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  failover: eu-only
  subprocessor_allowlist: ["aws:eu-west-1","gcp:europe-west1","oracle:europe"]
```
Tessa (Solutions): Note: control-plane signaling is minimal; we can enable telemetry opt-out for the POC and in-region log retention.
Vik (Infra): I'll validate the active subproc list and produce a simple network path diagram + cert bundle. Hosted geofence data plane endpoints are in eu-west/eu-central. If they pick eu-only failover we disable global fallthrough — works but reduces cross-region headroom. I'll upload artifacts to the handoff folder.
Claire (Legal): I can draft the attestation letter referencing our DPA once infra hands over the subproc inventory. I'll flag export-control language. ETA: 48-72 hours from infra confirmation.
Ben (Pricing): Ballpark: hosted geofence for 2M tokens/mo = $975/mo; dedicated reserved (monthly commit) ~ $560/mo; private VPC = $6k setup + $490/mo. These assume Llama-2 13B quant and ~10rps peak. SOC2 artifact access or extended logs will change price.
Owen (AM): @Ben please produce a formal quote. Customer requested attestation within 3 business days. @Vik can infra deliver subproc list today?
Vik (Infra): Yes — retrieving and validating now. I'll upload netdiag and subproc_list by EOD: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/medi-bank/poc. Also adding a short runbook note about egress-cost triggers.
Tessa (Solutions): Test curl to pin tenant to EU I'll include in playbook:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"medi-bank","region":"eu-central-1","policy":"eu-only"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/pin
```
Helena (Customer Sec): Please ensure audit logs are stored in-region for 90 days and provide SOC2 artifact access.
Claire (Legal): Noted; will include log retention and artifact access in the attestation draft.
Ben (Pricing): I'll send a draft quote tomorrow and call out the compliance surcharge scenarios. Need final model and concurrency to firm numbers.
Owen (AM): Proposed timeline: infra uploads today; pricing draft tomorrow; legal attestation in up to 3 business days after infra upload; playbook + perf baseline by Tessa tomorrow. Target kickoff next Thursday. Everyone good?
Tessa (Solutions): I'll create a 1-page POC playbook and include a small perf run to show p95 numbers.
Vik (Infra): Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/medi-bank/poc/netdiag.pdf and subproc_list.csv.
Ben (Pricing): Draft quote sent via email to Owen.
Claire (Legal): Attestation template drafted, will finalize after a quick security review.
Helena (Customer Sec): Thanks, please make sure the playbook includes a short fallback explanation if EU pools get saturated.
ops-bot: handoff artifacts staged (job id: 100442) :white_check_mark:
